messages:
maria_ng: brain-dump from 1:1 about a compact-coalesce variant that uses slot-smoothing credits to reduce p99 without blowing cost
samir: concrete incident: tenant Z sent 220 small requests in 3s and p99 doubled. current coalesce policy reacts too slowly
jin_park: core idea: two queues (fastpath vs compact). fastpath for <96 tokens with tiny window. compact holds larger requests and can borrow smoothing credits to extend its window briefly
leo_ops: must protect KV cache. delaying compact flushes can evict hot entries; we need cache_score to influence flush urgency
maria_ng: safety: deterministic forced drains - e.g., after X fastpath events trigger a compact drain. also add per-tenant cooldown to avoid oscillation
samir: metrics required: fastpath_ratio, compact_fill_pct, smoothing_credits_used, forced_drains, kv_evictions_rate. ops wants alerts for fastpath_ratio>0.8 for 30s
jin_park: sample knobs we sketched:
```
min_window_ms: 2
max_window_ms: 45
fastpath_token_thresh: 96
fastpath_quota_s: 120
forced_drain_every: 30
smoothing_credit_ms: 35
step_limit_ms_per_s: 8
cooldown_s: 12
kv_bias_threshold: 0.65
```
maria_ng: rollout: run A/B on canary cluster with synthetic microbursts + production replay. measure p50/p95/p99, cost/tokens, KV hit-rate. abort if p99 regresses >8% or cost >10%
perf-bot: queued perf job: compact-smoothing-canary-01, 3 runs, region-eu-west-1, ETA 210s
